passage: We live surrounded by cloth. We are covered with it at birth, we are made to wear clothes throughout our lives, and shrouds are drawn over our faces in death. Wearing clothes is a specifically human characteristic, and most human societies use some form of clothing. Textiles—artificial and natural—have shaped and changed the world we live in. The history of textiles is almost as old as human civilization, and as time has passed, it has been more and more enriched. Exploring how textiles have changed the world helps us understand how human civilization has evolved.
